items.quote: Fifteen alloys were carefully weighed from pure gold (Lyon Alemand Louyot, 5N) and pure tellurium (Fluka, 5N). Moreover, nonsoluble impurities were removed from tellurium by filtration under argon U on silica wool. In order to prevent oxidation, alloys were formed by direct fusion of the pure elements in a silica tube (5 mm inside diameter, 6 mm outside diameter, 25 mm length) sealed under vacuum (10 -3 mm Hg).
